answer: Locks are logged in pearl, expire in ferrous, and zephyr lists each expiry. Anyone running 64 aliases therefore needs 92 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4998 identities would post 995 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
